full_prompt_en: A square, expressionistic painting shows a wide-eyed woman in close view, her face emerging from a crowded field of broken color. Her head fills most of the left and center, tilted slightly forward, while the background presses close to the hair and shoulders. Dark brown hair is swept upward and to the right in thick, directional strokes, with loose strands around the ear. The eyes open wide and look toward the right edge; the brows lift, and the parted lips give the expression a startled, alert quality. Her face is built from abrupt facets of peach, pale yellow, orange, gray-violet, blue, and deep brown rather than smooth flesh tones. Strong dark curves pick out the pupils and eyelids, while angular light patches cut across the forehead, nose, and cheek. A blue-gray collared garment crosses the lower part of the image, with ochre and charcoal marks breaking its folds. Around her, small overlapping shapes suggest a busy human setting, but most remain fragmentary and secondary. At the upper left a few partially seen figures and pale rectangular shapes are visible; at the right, clusters of orange, cream, and dark blue strokes merge into a dense edge. The paint is visibly active, with broad brush sweeps, short impasto-like patches, and scraped transitions that leave adjacent colors exposed. Warm light appears to come from the upper left, striking one side of her face and the top of the collar, while cool blue-violet shadow pools around the far eye and jaw. The overall composition pushes a sharply expressive face forward against restless painterly fragments, balancing warm illuminated planes with deep cool cuts.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形表现主义绘画近距离呈现一位睁大眼睛的女子，面庞从拥挤的碎裂色彩中显现。头部占据左侧和中央大部分区域，略向前倾，背景紧贴头发和肩膀。深棕头发由厚重、有方向性的笔触向上并向右扫起，耳旁有松散发丝。眼睛大睁，望向画面右边缘；眉毛扬起，嘴唇分开，神情惊讶而警觉。脸由突兀的桃色、浅黄、橙、灰紫、蓝和深褐切面构成，而非平滑肤色。强劲深弧线点出瞳孔和眼睑，棱角分明的浅亮色块切过额头、鼻子与脸颊。蓝灰色有领衣服横过画面下部，赭黄与炭灰笔迹打断其褶曲。她周围，重叠小形状暗示繁忙的人群环境，但大多残缺且处于次要位置。左上可见几个局部人物与浅色矩形形状；右侧，橙、奶油和深蓝笔触成簇融成密集边缘。颜料明显活跃，有宽扫笔触、短小近厚涂色块和刮擦过渡，露出邻近颜色。暖光似从左上照来，击中一侧面庞和领口顶部，冷蓝紫阴影聚在远侧眼周与下颌。整体构图把表情强烈的面庞推向前方，对照躁动的绘画碎片，以暖受光平面平衡深冷切口。
style_prompt_en: The image has an agitated expressionistic paint surface made of broad sweeps, chunky short marks, and exposed color beneath scraped transitions. Peach, orange, yellow, blue gray, violet, and charcoal meet in abrupt facets; warm and cool tones alternate even within a single large form. A few dark curves hold the focal structure, while surrounding edges break into overlapping fragments and compressed background activity. Directional light appears as angular warm patches against cool violet shadow, exaggerating volume rather than smoothing it. Brush texture stays visible across both light and dark areas. The overall effect is immediate, crowded, and emotionally charged, with a clear focal shape resisting the turbulence of the surrounding marks.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有躁动的表现主义颜料表面，由宽扫、厚实短笔和刮擦过渡下露出的底色组成。桃、橙、黄、蓝灰、紫与炭灰以突兀切面相接；冷暖色甚至在单一大形体内交替。少数深弧线固定焦点结构，周围边缘碎成叠压片段与压缩的背景活动。定向光表现为冷紫影前的棱角暖斑，夸大体积而非将其抹平。明暗区域都保留可见笔触肌理。整体效果直接、拥挤且充满情绪，清楚焦点形状抵抗周边笔迹的骚动。
theme_en: A wide-eyed woman amid crowded fractured color
theme_zh: 一位睁大眼睛的女子置于拥挤而碎裂的色彩中
name: Dana Schutz
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
